p01-splash.why: The painted desert scene on the splash: a picture, so it is cut rather than redrawn. It fades to the sheet's own #1B181C by y 432, which is where the box ends. Everything the app draws over it is erased here and rebuilt live.

p07-hero.why: The starburst-over-a-book paywall hero, down to the first chip row at 500.5. Same rule: the close button, Restore, the pro lockup and the serif headline come off it and are rebuilt.

p10-news.why: The wire-photo thumbnail in the news card. Nothing is drawn over it, so it is cut whole.
